title: AgentSpec
description: factory-automation/product-integration/AGENT-CATALOG.md §A schema — the 11-section prompt anatomy, structured. One file per premade agent (PRs/model-factory-v1 T10).

runtime.description: OPTIONAL (added 2026-07-27, factory-graph-pr1 B3). What this agent costs when factory_node_run.py dispatches it headlessly. Before this the schema had no budget/model field at all and `additionalProperties: false`, so the dispatch had nothing to resolve and the numbers would have had to hide in the wrapper. Absent = fall back to factory_node_run.ROLE_DEFAULTS for the role_family; every existing spec omits it and still validates. `allowed_tools` may not contain `Task` — nested spawn makes the parent's budget cap meaningless — and the dispatcher strips it defensively regardless of what is written here.

executor.description: OPTIONAL (added 2026-07-29, factory-cursor-bridge-v1 C2, decision D1; `self_dispatch` added 2026-08-20, model-factory-cloud-dispatch-v1 ENVIRONMENT.md §5). Which runtime dispatches this spec: `tier2` (default when absent — headless Claude Code via tier2_run.sh, unchanged), `cursor_sdk` (a Cursor agent via factory_cursor_dispatch.py — controllable from the product: Stop/Pause/Resume/Send-message), or `self_dispatch` (the ORCHESTRATING agent's own `Task` tool — for a runtime that structurally cannot hold CURSOR_API_KEY or a local `claude` CLI credential, e.g. the cloud-dispatch routine session; see factory_node_run.py's `_dispatch_self` docstring for the two-call pause/resume protocol this requires). Opting a spec in is a deliberate per-spec edit, never a flag-day default. NOTE the tradeoff, stated in factory_cursor_dispatch.py's docstring: the cursor_sdk path has NO max_turns/budget_usd enforcement — those two fields and allowed_tools apply to tier2 only. `self_dispatch`'s cost enforcement is weaker still: self-reported by the orchestrating agent, not independently metered — see `_dispatch_self`.

cursor_model.description: OPTIONAL in schema but REQUIRED in practice for cursor_sdk specs: the Cursor model slug to dispatch with (e.g. composer-2.5-fast). The SDK's Agent.create refuses to default the model (startup_error 'missing_model', observed 2026-07-29 grand-steel S4) — set it on every cursor_sdk spec. Free-form because Cursor's slug set changes faster than this schema.

cursor_runtime.description: OPTIONAL, cursor_sdk executor only: `cloud` (default — runs on a Cursor-hosted VM against a fresh clone of origin, controllable from anywhere) or `local` (spawns on the dispatching machine; the per-dispatch fallback decision D2 anticipates for specs needing local-only resources).

context_sources.description: OPTIONAL (added 2026-07-27, factory-graph-pr1 B4). Run-kind-conditional reading, on top of — never instead of — `read_first`, which stays the always-on baseline. This is what lets a retrain inherit its predecessor's context (the digest, the last ship-gate rationale, the org's mixture history) while a first run is not handed dangling references to material that does not exist. Absent = behaves exactly as before.
